_comment: 'When you play this, if you have less {h} than an opposing hero, this gets +3{p}.' Shape copied from reckless_arithmetic_blue (PLAY + MODIFY_ATTACK on an Action - Attack); the handler records the mod on CombatState.power_mods so it survives later recalculations. HEALTH_LT_OPP (condition_types.py) takes no params and compares controller life < opposing hero life (two-player). Ability-level conditions are checked at resolution, which matches 'if you have less {h}' being tested when the card is played. No other clauses.
